name: Deoghar
registryAssessment: The official District Deoghar land-records page establishes a local government service context and links to Jharkhand's Jharbhoomi portal. The national Bhu-Naksha implementation directory links Jharkhand's cadastral viewer. The anonymous viewers could not be reached within bounded direct requests, so a local registry/cadastral geometry endpoint was not independently evidenced and registryFound remains null.

queries.query: Deoghar Jharkhand official cadastral parcel map Bhu Naksha Jharbhoomi
queries.result: Found the official District Deoghar land-records page, which describes Register-II and Khata/Khesra access and links to Jharbhoomi; found the official national Bhu-Naksha implementation directory linking Jharkhand's viewer.

queries.query: देवघर झारखंड आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा प्लॉट मानचित्र
queries.result: Found the official Hindi District Deoghar map page and the official Deoghar land-records service in English/Hindi site context. The page is a district map landing page, not a parcel-vector response; it points to government service navigation but does not expose native parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: District Deoghar, Government of Jharkhand official land-records service page
officialSources.observation: Search/open evidence states that the service provides Register-II, Khata & Khesra, and online mutation-status access, and links to https://jharbhoomi.jharkhand.gov.in/. This is local custodian evidence but not a parcel geometry response.

The current directory lists Jharkhand and links to https://jharbhunaksha.jharkhand.gov.in/. It establishes the official public viewer route but does not provide Deoghar parcel features in the directory response.

officialSources.role: District Deoghar official Hindi map page
officialSources.observation: The Hindi page is an official district map landing page and identifies district-administration ownership of the content; it contains no safe parcel ID, parcel geometry, cadastral schema, or CRS response.

geometryDecision.reason: No bounded anonymous response containing a safe native parcel identifier and full polygon was obtained. The WUP point was preserved exactly and was not shifted. Viewer timeout is not evidence of citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Deoghar district land-record service and Jharkhand Bhu-Naksha public viewer route.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service existence and viewer linkage were verified; current viewer JavaScript/configuration, API schema, CRS, native identity, exact-point containment, and citywide open parcel coverage were not verified.
